item.title: Creality Sermoon P1 review: This ultraportable handheld 3D scanner let me scan almost any object I wanted
item.description: The Creality Sermoon P1 is a handheld 3D scanner that combines multiple scanning technologies to ensure you can scan pretty much anything.

item.title: The best budget Fitbit with a 10-day battery life is now super-cheap after this price cut at Amazon
item.description: The Fitbit Inspire 3 is the top pick if you're looking for a budget fitness tracker, and it's now been reduced to a terrific low price on Amazon.

item.title: India central bank head says AI can approve loans humans would have turned down, says the technology is, 'a capability to be responsibly harnessed and not merely as a risk to be contained'
item.description: India's central bank wants AI deciding who can get a loan, as long as no bank ever tells a customer "the model decided.

item.title: Pourquoi nos smartphones n’ont pas grillé en photographiant l’éclipse
item.description: Le sujet a beaucoup circulé avant l'éclipse : prendre l'événement en photo risquait de brûler les capteurs de nos smartphones sans utiliser un filtre adéquat. Si les craintes sont fondées, notre expérience montre qu'elles sont peut-être un tantinet exagérées.

item.title: L’Ambilight aura rarement été aussi accessible qu’avec ce TV Philips 4K de 55″ bradé à seulement 379 €
item.description: Le Philips 55PUS8200 est un TV qui mise sur l'expérience Ambilight avec un écosystème simple pour des performances correctes au quotidien, vendu à 379 euros au lieu de 499 euros sur Amazon.

item.title: Google Workspace Promo Codes: 14% Off for August 2026
item.description: Boost your productivity and save with exclusive Google Workspace coupons from WIRED. Get up to 14% off plans for three months, including Starter, Standard, and Plus tiers.

item.title: I stopped writing careful ChatGPT prompts and rambled at it for 10 minutes instead — the results changed how I use AI
item.description: A messy, unfiltered conversation with ChatGPT produced more insightful answers than carefully crafted prompts

item.title: Why stability might be the smartest career move right now
item.description: In an uncertain job market, constantly chasing the next promotion or opportunity can come at a cost. Employees today are stressed, angry and sad, and they’re experiencing these emotions more than even before the COVID-19 pandemic, according to Gallup. A big reason for stress is a sense of job insecurity, according to research published by the American Psychological Association. ...

item.title: Who is pointing out your blind spots?
item.description: Leaders don’t lose deals because they lack information. They lose them when the relationships around them tell them what they want to hear. “I don’t understand. The deal was moving forward. My team’s reports said we were on track. I had lunch with their CEO last month, and everything felt solid.”
